content: Mean pooling for sentence embeddings: sum(token_embeddings * attention_mask_expanded, axis=1) / clamp(sum(attention_mask, axis=1), min=1e-9). L2 normalization: embedding / max(l2_norm(embedding), 1e-12). These operations must be applied manually when using raw ONNX model, as SentenceTransformer library handles them internally.
